final_message:
I reviewed all eight comments and saved a checklist for Friday’s final draft. Dr. Lindqvist’s Wednesday update allows planning help and asks you to write your own fixes, so the checklist uses questions you can work through.

I put your reply to Parfit first. If different choices would lead to different people being born, why do you think the duty still holds? The other items cover your thesis, the “most philosophers” claim, what the dam builders knew, the climate-cost comparison, and the run-on in paragraph 3.

Monday’s accepted suggestion already fixed the dam paragraph’s comma splice. The checklist flags it for your own punctuation review. The Parfit citation suggestion is still pending, so I included a reminder to verify the page in your copy. The paper is due Friday, March 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
